title: Backups
description: Every save keeps the version it replaced and every delete keeps the final state, so a bad edit or an accidental delete is one tcms backup:restore away. Records only, unless you turn on the file settings below: then replaced and removed images and files are kept too, and a restore puts them back. Snapshots live in tcms-data/.system/backups/ and survive application updates. This is an undo history, not a site backup: keep backing up tcms-data/.

enable.label: Keep Object History
enable.help: Master switch. When off, saves and deletes write no snapshots and no files are kept. Existing snapshots are left in place and still restore. Sync's pre-overwrite snapshots are unaffected by this setting.

keep.label: Snapshots per Object
keep.help: The newest snapshots each object keeps; older ones are pruned on the next save. Identical consecutive saves do not stack a duplicate. Raise this on a busy editorial site; it only costs the size of the record's JSON per snapshot.

maxAgeDays.label: Maximum Age (days)
maxAgeDays.help: Applies to snapshots and to uploaded files: a snapshot, a kept image or file, or anything in the trash is deleted once it is older than this, whatever the counts say. Without it, one busy afternoon of edits would evict last week's version, the one you actually wanted. Set to 0 to switch the age rule off: snapshots and kept images and files then stay until their count removes them, and the trash is emptied after 30 days.

keepImages.label: Earlier Images per Field
keepImages.help: How many replaced or removed images each image field of an object keeps, so restoring a snapshot brings its image back. That includes an image field inside a card or a deck item, and a video's poster. 0 keeps none: a replaced image is deleted, as before. Each kept image is the full original, so this uses real disk space. Gallery pictures go to the trash instead.

keepFiles.label: Earlier Files per Field
keepFiles.help: How many replaced or removed files each file field of an object keeps, including a file field inside a card or a deck item. 0 keeps none. Each kept file is the full original: with large downloads, a small number here can use a lot of disk. Depot files go to the trash instead.

trash.label: Trash for Galleries and Depots
trash.help: Keep the pictures removed from a gallery and the files and folders removed from a depot, so restoring a snapshot brings them back. There is no count: everything removed is kept until it is older than Maximum Age, then deleted. Deleting a large depot therefore holds its disk space for that long.

maxFileSizeMB.label: Largest File Kept (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.help: A file larger than this is never kept, by any of the three settings above: it is deleted when it is replaced or removed, as before. Set to 0 for no limit.
